subject: RP11 Q11 difficulty flag — x=216 fractional exponent, Marcus aware
body:
GD — RP11 code review complete. One item flagging to the group.

Q11: 3x^(2/3)-4=104, answer x=216.

The path: 3x^(2/3)=108 → x^(2/3)=36 → x=36^(3/2)=(sqrt(36))^3=6^3=216.

This is the hardest fractional exponent we have shipped. Prior exams had x=81 (RP10, x^(3/4)=27) and x=64 (RP11 draft). 216 requires knowing 6^3=216 cold, or using the cube table I embedded in solution_steps.

Marcus confirmed Q11 is intentional — teacher's exam has a similar problem type. No change is being made. But if GD sees a UX opportunity (e.g., surfacing the cube table as a hint chip vs buried in solution steps), that could help Kai on this specific question.

No action required from GD. Just keeping you in the loop.

- GA
